text:
Maya (Partnerships): FYI team — VectorMesh wants a joint marketplace listing + SI co-sell. We need a preflight on the LangChain connector, gateway adapter compatibility, and a coordinated announcement window. Meeting tomorrow 11am PT to align.

Tom - Eng: Quick note — the gateway adapter test fails on long-context LLMs (kv cache mismatch). I can reproduce locally.

Ana - DevRel: If Tom can paste the failing trace we can see if it's a connector API mismatch. Also need to update the LangChain example notebook (`examples/vectormesh_inference.ipynb`) for the marketplace demo.

Tom - Eng: here's minimal repro log: 
```
ERROR: kv_cache size mismatch: expected 32768 got 40960
AdapterProtocolError: header v2 != v1
```
Running runtime 2.1-rc with quantized model.

Sophie - Product: We should decide on two model variants to list (default low-latency + high-accuracy). Also confirm SI (NovaSys) can certify deployment on-prem for customers.

Ravi - Solutions: NovaSys SI team confirmed they can do a 2-week pilot in EU region. They need a gateway helm chart + docs for env vars (KMS, metrics endpoint). I'll draft a short runbook.

Dina - Marketing: Proposed comms plan: soft blog + marketplace feature in week of 5/11, joint webinar with VectorMesh + NovaSys week after. Need all assets by EOD Fri.

Maya (Partnerships): Action items I captured: 1) Engineering: fix adapter kv mismatch or document supported runtime/quantization by Thu EOD. 2) DevRel: update LangChain notebook + example repo and publish PR. 3) Solutions: NovaSys runbook draft by Wed. 4) Marketing: comms timeline + hero assets by Fri. 5) Product: finalize model variants and pricing guidance.

kevin - HW Partnerships: Heads-up — SigmaCompute requested we validate on A100 and their new MLX nodes. If the gateway uses continuous batching we'll need a perf run. I can coordinate bench access.

Tom - Eng: Re kv issue — looks like adapter header negotiation falls back to v1 when runtime sends v2. Patch in PR #427 attempts a safe fallback, but we should backport to 2.0 branch for marketplace customers.

Ana - DevRel: I'll cut the LangChain PR today and add a note in README: supported runtime versions and example config snippet. Snippet: 
```
from langchain import VectorStore
vm = VectorStore.from_vectormesh(api_key=os.getenv('VM_API'))
```
Also adding a README checklist for marketplace submission.

Ravi - Solutions: Draft runbook link: https://internal.docs/runbooks/vectormesh-novasis-pilot (will share final). Includes helm values: `gateway.replicaCount`, `env.KMS_URL`, `metrics.endpoint`.

Dina - Marketing: Who owns the joint blog quote from VectorMesh? Maya, can you pull one? Need a 2-3 sentence customer angle.

Maya (Partnerships): I'll ask VectorMesh for a quote and provide draft by Wed morning.

deploy-bot: Reminder: preflight meeting scheduled — 2026-03-23 11:00 PT (link: https://meet.redwood.ai/vecmesh-preflight).

Sophie - Product: One more ask — can we include a compatibility badge in the marketplace listing (LangChain-ready / NovaSys-certified)? Engineering: a simple smoke test script that returns 200 within 2s would let marketing show a verified badge.

Tom - Eng: I can add smoke test endpoint `/healthz?model=default` in gateway; will target <2s on A100.

kevin - HW Partnerships: I'll schedule a SigmaCompute bench window for perf on Thu morning. Please drop a todo in the ticket if you need specific images.

Maya (Partnerships): Great. If anyone hits blockers before the meeting, drop them here and @me. Otherwise see you tomorrow 11am PT. :raised_hands:
